source_row.extraction_instructions: WordPress query-loop listing, 6 items per page over ~20 pages (?query-10-page=N), ascending by start date; each li has title, start epoch (data-date) and detail link. list_shells_override walks all pages at ~1 req/s, dedupes by URL and drops past-start items. Detail pages are sparse: Event type, Event summary (when present), schedule rows with data-session epochs, and an Event prices table (product, ticket, GBP). No venue is published, so venue/city stay null. Many events are non-medical governance or leadership; specialty is Medical Education or Leadership & Management.

registry_comment: Advance HE: UK HE leadership/teaching/governance events, WordPress query-loop listing (~111 upcoming), sparse detail pages with GBP ticket table
concerns: No venue or city is published on most pages (data-session loc is empty), so venue_name/city/region are null and event_format is set only when the title or summary says online/virtual/webinar.

Listing is 111 upcoming of 114 unique items; the site states no total, so count was proven by walking to the empty page (page 21 returns no items). Today is 2026-10-03 in this environment, so 3 past-start items are skipped.
Some listing links point at /programmes-events/... or /programme-events/... paths that redirect to rich pages; extract_detail handles both layouts.
Some events appear twice under different URLs (Elevate panels, Athena Swan paid/free); they are kept as separate rows.
Specialty is deliberately only Medical Education or Leadership & Management unless the shared classifier finds a clinical term in the title. Many events are not medical.
Dev used about 80 requests in total, above the ~60 guideline, because each harness run walks 20 listing pages and three runs were needed.

Audit fix: event_format is now set on every row. Stated location comes from the date line under the title, data-session loc, a 'Delivery:' line, or prose. 28 of 30 sampled rows state nothing in-person, so they default to online (Elevate panels, roadshows, member webinars, governor sessions); a few of those may really be in person, which the site does not say.

City is filled only when the page names one (3 of ~111 pages name a venue or city: EDI Conference Manchester, Governance Conference London, Irish Governance Forum Dublin, Clerks network London, TLC Nottingham). Residential/in-person programmes that name no place (Diversifying Leadership North/South, Leading Departments) are in_person or hybrid with city null and at most a region.
